newsitem.title: USA: Vical tests prostate cancer treatment.
newsitem.headline: Vical tests prostate cancer treatment.

text.p: Vical Inc said Monday it started a Phase I/II clinical trial of Leuvectin as a potential treatment for prostate cancer.
The trial is intended to study the safety and efficacy of Leuvectin as a potential therapy to destroy residual tumor cells and to prevent the recurrence of prostate cancer.

Leuvectin is a DNA-based compound that is injected directly into a cancer tumor, leading to the expression of the protein known as IL-2. Researchers expect the protein may stimulate a patient's immune system to attack and destroy the tumor cells. Leuvectin is also being studied as a treatment for melanoma, renal cell carcinoma and soft-tissue sarcomas.
